points.description: States FALSE (the process is not always rescheduled immediately after the interrupt handler completes).
points.partial_credit: Do not give part marks; the verdict must be False. If verdict is True or missing, 0 for this point.

points.description: Justification: after the interrupt handler finishes, the scheduler may pick a different process to run, e.g. because the interrupted process's time slice/quantum has expired (or another process is chosen by the scheduler).
points.partial_credit: Half mark if the student says another process may be scheduled but gives no reason (no mention of time slice expiry or scheduler decision), or states the idea vaguely.

rubric.notes: Full marks need FALSE plus a correct justification that another process can be scheduled next, e.g. because the time slice has expired. Part marks for False with a vague justification (another process may run, no reason). A True answer, or False with a wrong or missing justification, gets 0 for the justification; the question says no correct justification means no marks, so give 0 overall if the justification is wrong.
